xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-3230: orphan-proposed-reconciler reads legacy <project>/.pan/specs — blind to migrated projects since PAN-2541 (79 proposed specs invisible in the state worktree)

plan.title: orphan-proposed-reconciler reads legacy <project>/.pan/specs — blind to migrated projects since PAN-2541
plan.author: agent:claude-fable-5

references.label: PAN-2541 (state migration that introduced the split)

metadata.sizeJustification: One bug class (hardcoded legacy .pan/specs|.pan/drafts joins bypassing getProjectPanPaths) fixed at every live call site plus the lint guard that proves the sweep is complete. Each caller fix is a 1-3 line substitution; splitting them into sibling issues would leave the guard unlandable (it fails while any caller remains unfixed) and cost more pipeline overhead than the changes themselves. 13 files, 7 counted subsystems only because scripts/, package.json, docs/, and tests/unit each count as one.

narratives.Problem: Eight live call sites derive spec/draft directories as join(projectRoot, '.pan', 'specs'|'drafts') instead of the state-branch-aware getProjectPanPaths (src/lib/pan-dir/paths.ts). For projects migrated to the overdeck-state worktree (PAN-2541), those directories are frozen pre-cutover snapshots, so the orphan-proposed reconciler has enumerated zero candidates for 18 days (79 proposed specs invisible), pan doctor under-reports, flywheel/backlog planned-and-PRD detection fails, --plan skip auto-start 422s (spec written to the wrong dir), and standing-tier supervisors read no PRD. Same class as PAN-3165, which fixed only xbrief-index.ts.
narratives.Proposal: Substitute getProjectPanPaths(projectRoot).specsDir/.draftsDir at every live caller (reconciler, doctor, flywheel, backlog trio, auto-synthesize write path, tier-supervisor), add migrated-project regression tests following the xbrief-index.test.ts OVERDECK_HOME + migration-complete.json pattern, and add scripts/lint-state-paths.sh to the npm run lint chain so the hardcoded join shape can never land again outside an audited allowlist. Full details, before/after snippets, and the deliberate-legacy allowlist are in the PRD (drafts/pan-3230.md).
narratives.NonGoals:
- No changes to the pickup gate (autonomous-work-dispatch.ts) — the 79 newly visible candidates must stay behind the existing fail-closed dispatch predicate
- No changes to deliberately dual-path/legacy-aware sites: pan-dir/**, state-read-home.ts, state-plane.ts, pan-dir/auto-commit.ts, orders/validate.ts, merge-agent.ts SYNC_MAIN_MAIN_PREFERRED_PATHS, planning-promotion.ts, admin/state-migrate.ts
- No manual git add/commit/push of state-worktree files — persistence stays with the state write door and reconcileStatePlaneDrift
- No migration of additional projects and no changes to the migration marker format
- No refactor of the reconciler's candidate-filtering or spawn logic beyond path resolution

autoDecisions.summary: Fix all audited live callers in this issue instead of filing sibling issues.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue's Fix section mandates the caller audit; each fix is a 1-3 line substitution of an established pattern (PAN-3165 precedent) and the projected surface (~13 files, exactly 6 subsystems) fits the finalize decomposition caps.

autoDecisions.summary: Include drafts-dir joins in the files already touched, and cover drafts in the lint guard.
autoDecisions.rationale: Drafts detection fails identically for migrated projects; the read door already exposes draftsDir; a specs-only guard would leave half the bug class unprotected.

autoDecisions.summary: Include the write-side auto-synthesize.ts fix (directory substitution only).
autoDecisions.rationale: It produces the same invisible-spec symptom and breaks --plan skip auto-start on migrated projects because findPlan is already state-branch aware; git persistence remains owned by reconcileStatePlaneDrift so the change stays read-door-shaped.

autoDecisions.summary: Guard matches the code join shape with a file allowlist rather than banning the substring everywhere.
autoDecisions.rationale: Prose mentions in comments and operator-message strings are legitimate; deliberately dual-path sites (migration tooling, sync-main conflict preferences, orders validation) must keep their legacy joins.

Every item applies a mechanically established pattern with an existing precedent fix and existing test scaffolding; no item lays a foundation another item's internal structure depends on — the guard item depends only on the fixes having shipped, which its own lint run verifies.

items.title: Route orphan-proposed reconciler spec-dir resolution through getProjectPanPaths

expected_outputs: orphan-proposed-reconciler.test.ts passes including new migrated-project cases

narrative.Action: Replace join(projectPath, '.pan', 'specs') at orphan-proposed-reconciler.ts:123 (findSpecPathForIssue) and join(config.path, '.pan', 'specs') at :216 (findOrphanProposedSpecsForReconciler) with getProjectPanPaths(<projectRoot>).specsDir, importing getProjectPanPaths from '../pan-dir/paths.js'. Add migrated-project regression tests to the existing suite using its OVERDECK_HOME isolation (test file lines 161-162): write migration-complete.json ({version:1, sourceMainSha:'a'.repeat(40), stateBranchSha:'b'.repeat(40), completedAt: ISO}) into $OVERDECK_HOME/state/<basename(projectPath)>/ and place a proposed spec in <stateRoot>/specs/, per the pattern in src/lib/xbrief/__tests__/xbrief-index.test.ts:48-61. Existing unmigrated tests stay unmodified.

No behavior change for unmigrated projects (resolver falls back to <legacyRoot>/.pan).

Add lint-state-paths guard to the lint chain and document the path authority

expected_outputs: lint-state-paths.sh exits 0 on the fixed tree
lint-state-paths.test.ts passes: guard exits 1 on a fixture with a hardcoded join, exits 0 on a comment-only fixture
npm run lint completes with the lint:state-paths step included and passing

narrative.Action: Create scripts/lint-state-paths.sh: greps src/ (optional scan-root argument, default src/, for testability) for the hardcoded join shapes — '.pan', 'specs' / '.pan', 'drafts' (single or double quotes) and the string forms '.pan/specs' / '.pan/drafts' — excluding the audited allowlist files (src/lib/pan-dir/**, src/lib/state-read-home.ts, src/lib/state-plane.ts, src/lib/orders/validate.ts, src/lib/cloister/merge-agent.ts, src/lib/overdeck/planning-promotion.ts, src/cli/commands/admin/state-migrate.ts, src/lib/cloister/verification-runner.ts) and comment-only/prose lines; prints offending file:line entries and exits 1 on any hit. Wire "lint:state-paths": "bash scripts/lint-state-paths.sh" into package.json scripts and append && npm run lint:state-paths to the lint chain (package.json:105). Add tests/unit/scripts/lint-state-paths.test.ts following tests/unit/scripts/lint-ratchet-audit.test.ts: fixture tree with one offending join (guard exits 1, names the file) and one prose/comment mention (guard exits 0). Docs: add a 'Path authority' subsection to docs/AGENT-STATE-PLANES.md stating that all spec/draft directory derivation goes through getProjectPanPaths in src/lib/pan-dir/paths.ts (state worktree for migrated projects, legacy .pan/ otherwise), citing PAN-3165/PAN-3230 as the recurrences, and naming scripts/lint-state-paths.sh as the CI enforcement.

items.title: scripts/lint-state-paths.sh exits 1 and prints the offending file:line when a non-allowlisted src/ file contains a hardcoded '.pan', 'specs' or '.pan', 'drafts' join (proven by the fixture test), and exits 0 on the fixed working tree
The guard exits 0 on a fixture containing only a prose/comment mention of .pan/specs, and allowlisted files retain their legacy joins without tripping it
package.json defines lint:state-paths and the npm run lint chain invokes it, so npm run lint fails when a new hardcoded join is introduced
docs/AGENT-STATE-PLANES.md contains a Path authority subsection naming getProjectPanPaths as the single derivation point for spec/draft directories and scripts/lint-state-paths.sh as its enforcement
